description: POST /v1/capabilities/{key}/quote: price preview only — does NOT run the capability, does NOT create a job, and does NOT charge or hold wallet funds. Use when the user asks how much something would cost or wants an estimate before deciding to execute; use hydracept_run or hydracept_submit_job only if they explicitly want execution. Not the same as request_capability_quote (full profile; commission / human-paid). Auth: bearer API key required. Cost: none. Side effects: none.
